title: How to clean a wooden cutting board

pieces.say: Stop soaking your wooden cutting board. Seriously.
pieces.text: Stop soaking your wooden cutting board. Seriously.
pieces.label: YOU'RE DOING IT WRONG

pieces.say: Here's the fix. Coarse salt and half a lemon.
Wash with hot water and a drop of soap.
Sprinkle coarse salt, then scrub with half a lemon.
Rinse, then dry it standing upright.
Once a month, rub in food-safe mineral oil.
Never soak it, no dishwasher, no bleach, never mix cleaners.
pieces.text: No soaking. No dishwasher. No bleach.

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
